item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-01 23:59
Institution: Politecnico di BARI, Bari
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-09 Progettazione architettonica

The post holder will provide specialist technical support for digital fabrication activities applied to construction, architecture and design, with responsibilities for laboratory management, tutoring, applied research and technology transfer. In particular, the role will involve 2D/3D modelling, preparation of CAM outputs, prototyping using 3D printing, laser cutting and CNC machines, process automation, management of experiments, processing of experimental data, and support for technical and project documentation

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-01 23:59
Institution: Politecnico di BARI, Bari
Field: Civil engineering and architecture / 08/CEAR-03 Infrastrutture e sistemi di trasporto, estimo e valutazione

The Technologist will be required to manage complex research infrastructure, the associated equipment and specialised software, including a mobile laboratory and the fleet of electric micromobility vehicles. He/She will support experimental activities, simulations and tests concerning land transport and mobility systems, networks, and the performance assessment of passenger and freight transport systems. The postholder will be involved in preparing practical/Lab teaching sessions, managing equipment and monitoring projects on smart, autonomous and sustainable mobility.
